pages.text: Blackberries come from the Blackberry Crop. Once the crop is fully grown, harvesting it gives you blackberries.$(br2)They're useful on their own, but they can also be used in other recipes.

pages.title: Blackberry
pages.text: Freshly harvested blackberries are used in several foods added by Moon's Whatsits.$(br2)See $(l:whatsits:foods_drinks)Food & Drinks$(/l) for some of the things you can make with them.
